findings.comment: Transformer pad access door orientation is not indicated on the electrical plan. Without door orientation, the required 10-foot minimum clearance to open area or adjacent building/structure cannot be verified. The south pad is 5.9 feet from Building 7; if the access door faces this building, the 10-foot requirement would not be met.

No cross-section drawings are provided showing vertical clearances in access paths or demonstrating clearances to any overhead structures, parking garages, or enclosed areas associated with transformer locations. Vertical clearance compliance cannot be verified.

Transformer easements are not shown on any of the site plan sheets. No easement boundaries or widths are depicted around the transformer pads to accommodate Austin Energy accessibility and maintenance requirements.

Transformer pad dimensions are not labeled or dimensioned on the electrical plan. No reference callouts to Austin Energy Design-approved transformer pad detail sheets are provided. Compliance with AE Design pad specifications for the specified service type cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: transformer pad in south area near Building 7
findings.comment: The transformer pad in the south area (near Building 7) is located 3.2 feet from the nearest vehicle circulation route, which is within the 4-foot threshold requiring bollard protection. No 4-inch minimum diameter galvanized bollards are shown on the electrical plan or any detail sheets. Bollards are required per AE Design equipment pad specifications.
